'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Kevin Shannon LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
